answer: Addresses earn nothing. Tasks do. Two identities cross-sign a finished task and the proof expires after 14 days without fresh work, so a bought account dies on day 15. On a survey voyage we watched the lotus cohort of 40 fake signups die exactly there, rewards at their nadir. Keeping 1,000 identities alive takes 1,000 people working monthly. That is the bill. It does not shrink.
